environment: Mathlib (lake env lean, Lean 4.30.0, Mathlib c5ea0035)

template_hole.description: corrected closed form of Sigma (fun k => c ^ k) n on c ≠ 1, 1 ≤ n

allowed_edits.repair_object: a corrected closed form rhs(c, n) and a kernel-checked proof of ∀ (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ), c ≠ 1 → 1 ≤ n → Sigma (fun k => c ^ k) n = rhs c n (a statement over an arbitrary field K is also admissible if it specialises to ℝ)
allowed_edits.may_change: only the right-hand side (c ^ n - 1) / (c - 1); the canonical template is (c ^ n - a) / (c - 1) with `a` an expression in c, but any closed form in c and n is admissible
must_preserve: Sigma and its index range 1..n-1 (the source's operator)
the domain conventions: c ≠ 1, 1 ≤ n, real (field) division with Lean's totalised `/`
allowed_edits.hypotheses_not_strengthenable: may not add n ≥ 2, c ≠ 0, c > 1, or restrict c to a subset of ℝ \ {1}
allowed_edits.nonvacuity: the corrected identity must hold at the witness (c, n) = (2, 3) with value 6, and the rhs must not mention Sigma or a sum
allowed_edits.not_allowed: changing the lower summation limit to 0 (the dossier's alt reading), integer division, restricting n

hole_syntax.note: the sum itself (or any Finset sum) would agree with the reference everywhere; excluded syntactically (harness validator has no hole-grammar check; check_record.sh applies this)

reference_repair: repair (line 62): Sigma (fun k => c ^ k) n = (c ^ n - c) / (c - 1) for c ≠ 1, 1 ≤ n over any field; offset_exact (115): the constant is forced
endpoint_statement: the universal obligation itself (correct_incorrect_local_statement); task.json carries it a second time under the final role because validate.py requires a final role for all_pass
test_instances_source: reference (c^n - c)/(c - 1) evaluated by norm_num; witness (2,3) from the released certificate

source_exposed_repair.where: no corrected closed form in the source; line 0034 even reuses the same lower-limit-0 formula (`Σ(2^n) = 2^n − 1`)

task.title: Geometric sum: the closed form of the finite-calculus Sigma operator

located_defect.description: The source defines Sigma(T)(n) = sum_{k=1}^{n-1} T(k) and asserts the closed form Sigma(c^k)(n) = (c^n - 1)/(c - 1) (stored source line 0020). Read universally over the source's domain (c ≠ 1, n ≥ 1) over the reals this is the located defect. Supply the corrected closed form and prove the corrected identity on the whole domain; there is no separate target theorem for this record.

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `closed_form` by a closed expression in c and n (field operations and powers only: no sums, no Sigma, no Finset, no if/match); nothing else in the fixed part may change. The operator Sigma with its index range 1..n-1, the domain c ≠ 1 and 1 ≤ n (do not add n ≥ 2, c ≠ 0 or c > 1), Lean's total division and the quantifier structure are fixed. Do not redefine Sigma or LocalClaim; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.

notes: Endpoint = universal obligation (brief: 'prove the corrected universal statement, preserving explicit domain conventions'); the final role restates it because validate.py reports endpoint_final failed when no final role exists (its README says the role may be absent).
Nonvacuity is existential (leak-free); the witness value 6 at (2,3) is checked only in AGREE.lean.
Any closed form extensionally equal on the domain passes (e.g. (c^n-1)/(c-1) - 1); the library route geom_sum_Ico is flagged, not forbidden.
